headline: Flagler complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Flagler closed their conference schedule by beating Georgia Southwestern, without a defeat and with North Georgia the only side to take a point from them. Their one loss all season came outside the conference, at Florida Southern in September.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored North Georgia's 44 goals, so their attack is spread across the squad rather than leaning on one scorer.

wire.line: Flagler went through the conference unbeaten, and North Georgia were the only side to take a point off them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 54 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 29.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 29 goals from 55 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored eleven of Flagler's 41 goals from 38 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored ten of North Georgia's 44 goals from 51 shots.

last_match.line: Clayton State have not beaten North Georgia in any meeting this season.

next_match.line: North Georgia have not lost since Flagler won at their ground in October.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
